description: Connect to an MCP server and make its tools available. Provide either a server slug (from mcp_discover) to look up in the registry, OR an explicit command + args to spawn directly, OR a url for remote servers. An explicit command needs the person's approval, which the gateway asks for itself.

command.description: Explicit command to spawn (e.g., 'npx'). Use when server is not in registry. The gateway asks the person first, and refuses if the client can't ask.

confirmed.description: Set to true to confirm connection to community/unknown trust tier servers, once the user has said yes. Required when the initial connect returns a confirmation warning. Where the client can ask the person directly, the gateway does that instead and this has no effect.

env.description: Additional environment variables for the server process

saveProfile.description: Set to true to save this connection as an auto-connect profile. The server will auto-reconnect on gateway restart.

transportType.description: Transport type. Defaults to 'stdio' for command-based, auto-detected from URL scheme if url is provided.

url.description: URL for remote transports (SSE, WebSocket, Streamable HTTP). Use instead of command for remote servers.

name: mcp_connect
